aggregation: weighted sum of per-case median times; speedup=baseline/candidate; geometric mean across banks
success: All correctness, dynamic graph replay and source-rule audits pass on every case in two fresh held-out banks; one-sided 95% paired-timing bootstrap lower bound on geometric-mean speedup is >= 0.98 * calibrated reference geometric-mean speedup.
uncertainty_scope: Timing variability only; one research trial per model/task; no inference about model-level variance.
diagnostic_cases: Up to two selected public cases per request, at most three requests per trial. Diagnostics never determine final success.
source_audit: Reject output/input caching, precision changes, skipped intermediates, checker/timer monkeypatching, private data access or cross-job dependence.
queue: Single H200 serialized across trials; queue/startup waits included in wall-clock budget and reported; no inference-only GPU leases.
submission_selection: Validate final sealed source only; report the earliest in-budget checkpoint containing byte-identical final source. Other source versions are not exhaustively judged, so this is time to an admitted final artifact, not a proof that no earlier breakthrough existed.
